an4.97:1.5: n' ev' attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāya,
an4.97:1.6: attahitāya ca paṭipanno hoti parahitāya ca. 2.
an4.97:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāya?
an4.97:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo khippanisantī ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu sutānañ ca dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti dhatānañ ca dhammānaṃ atthūpaparikkhī hoti attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti,
an4.97:2.3: no ca kalyāṇavāco hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā, n' eva sandassako hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnaṃ.
an4.97:2.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāya. 3.
an4.97:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo parahitāya paṭipanno hoti no attahitāya?
an4.97:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo na h' eva kho khippanisantī hoti kusalesu dhammesu no ca sutānaṃ dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti, no ca dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthūpaparikkhī hoti, no ca attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhamma-paṭipanno hoti,
an4.97:3.3: kalyāṇavāco ca hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā, sandassako hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnaṃ.
an4.97:3.4: Evam kho bhikkhave puggalo parahitāya paṭipanno hoti no attahitāya. 4.
an4.97:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo n' ev' attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāya?
an4.97:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo na h' eva kho khippanisantī hoti kusalesu dhammesu no ca sutānaṃ dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti, no ca dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthūpaparikkhī hoti, no ca attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhamma-paṭipanno hoti,
an4.97:4.3: no ca kalyāṇavāco hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā, no ca sandassako hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnaṃ.
an4.97:4.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo n' ev' attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāya. 5.
an4.97:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo attahitāya ca paṭipanno hoti parahitāya ca?
an4.97:5.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo khippanisantī hoti kusalesu dhammesu sutānañ ca dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti, dhatānañ ca dhammānaṃ atthūpaparikkhī hoti, attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti,
an4.97:5.3: kalyāṇavāco ca hoti, kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā sandassako ca hoti samādapako . . . sabrahmacārīnaṃ.
an4.97:5.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo attahitāya ca paṭipanno hoti parahitāya ca.
an4.97:5.5: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānaṃ lokasmin ti. 98. 1. Cattāro
